structure Qubit where
  a : ℂ
  b : ℂ
  deriving Repr

def Qubit.normSquared (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  Complex.normSq q.a + Complex.normSq q.b

def Qubit.isNormalized (q : Qubit) : Prop :=
  abs (q.normSquared - 1) < 0.000001

def Qubit.normalize (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let ns := q.normSquared
  if h : ns > 0 then
    let invNorm := 1 / Real.sqrt ns
    ⟨q.a * invNorm, q.b * invNorm⟩
  else
    ⟨1, 0⟩

def Qubit.init (a b : ℂ) : Qubit :=
  Qubit.normalize ⟨a, b⟩

def Qubit.initBasis0 : Qubit :=
  ⟨1, 0⟩

def Qubit.initBasis1 : Qubit :=
  ⟨0, 1⟩

def Qubit.prob0 (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  min 1 (max 0 (Complex.normSq q.a))

def Qubit.prob1 (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  min 1 (max 0 (Complex.normSq q.b))

theorem Qubit.initBasis0_normalized : Qubit.isNormalized Qubit.initBasis0 := by
  unfold Qubit.isNormalized Qubit.initBasis0 Qubit.normSquared

  simp [Complex.normSq]

def hadamardGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let invSqrt2 := (1 : ℂ) / Complex.ofReal (Real.sqrt 2)
  let a' := (q.a + q.b) * invSqrt2
  let b' := (q.a - q.b) * invSqrt2
  Qubit.init a' b'

  (data : String) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph × String :=
  let hash := Std.hash data
  let nodeId := toString hash
  let node := Node.init nodeId data Qubit.initBasis0 0
  let g' := g.addNode node
  -- Add edges to existing nodes for connectivity
  let existingNodes := g.nodes.toList.map (·.1)

def hadamardGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let invSqrt2 := (1 : ℂ) / Complex.ofReal (Real.sqrt 2)
  let a' := (q.a + q.b) * invSqrt2
  let b' := (q.a - q.b) * invSqrt2
  Qubit.init a' b'

  let i := Complex.I

  Qubit.init (minusI * q.b) (i * q.a)

def pauliZGate (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  Qubit.init q.a (-q.b)

  · constructor

    · constructor

        · simp [String.mk, List.replicate, List.length_replicate]

def SelfSimilarRelationalGraph.encodeInformation (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph)
  (data : String) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph × String :=
  let hash := Std.hash data
  let nodeId := toString hash
  let node := Node.init nodeId data Qubit.initBasis0 0
  let g' := g.addNode node
  -- Add edges to existing nodes for connectivity
  let existingNodes := g.nodes.toList.map (·.1)
  let g'' := existingNodes.take 3 |>.foldl (fun acc targetId =>
    if targetId ≠ nodeId then
      let e := Edge.init nodeId targetId EdgeQuality.coherent 0.5 0 0
      acc.addEdge nodeId targetId e
    else acc) g'
  (g'', nodeId)
